title: 3D Virtual Element Method for Advection-Diffusion-Reaction Problems with Variable Coefficients on Locally Quasi-Uniform Polytopes
summary: In this paper, we propose and analyze a Continuous Interior Penalty (CIP) stabilized Virtual Element Method (VEM) for three-dimensional advection-diffusion-reaction equations on general polyhedral meshes. While CIP-VEM schemes have been recently explored in a two-dimensional setting, their analysis heavily relies on global mesh quasi-uniformity and constant physical parameters. We overcome these limitations by introducing a novel three-dimensional variant of the Oswald-type quasi-interpolant.
